candidate.name: Vineeth Prathapachandra Kaimal
candidate.title: Technical Leader | Power Integrity, Thermal & Packaging

summary.default: Results-driven engineering leader with 15 years of expertise in Power Integrity, Advanced Packaging, SoC PDN sign-off, and Thermal Analysis. Demonstrated success in building and directing global cross-functional teams (25+ engineers), setting technical strategy, and delivering AI-driven automation platforms that reduce silicon area, lower cost, and ensure product reliability across cutting-edge technology nodes.

experience.scope: System-level PI, Advanced Packaging & Thermal Leadership
bullets: Define and own technical strategy for system-level power integrity and package thermal sign-off across high-speed product portfolios.
Architect and lead development of AI-driven automation platforms for package ball visualization, layout modification, and ballout optimization – directly reducing design cycle time.
Drive SoC die size optimization from a PI perspective, delivering measurable silicon area and cost reduction.
Lead advanced package-level and component thermal analysis programs to proactively mitigate reliability risks.

experience.scope: SoC & Hard-Macro PDN Sign-off | Team Lead
bullets: Built, mentored, and directed a 25-member global engineering team delivering 6+ concurrent sign-off programs across 3lpe, 4ff, 5lpe, and 7ff nodes.
Owned end-to-end SoC PDN sign-off strategy; drove early floorplan architecture, padring layout, bump planning, and ESD placement decisions.
Successfully led the Hard-Macro level Power Delivery Network (PDN) sign-off team to ensure PDN convergence is seamless with best-in-class quality metrics.
Provided feedback about PDN health to HM PD implementation engineers from floorplan stage to Metal Tape-Out.
Engineered 200+ automation scripts (Perl/Tcl) and an automated HTML reporting system, unifying sign-off visibility across all hard macros.
Leveraged ANSYS RedHawk, RedHawk-SC, and Cadence Voltus for static/dynamic IR drop, signal EM, and ESD clamp-to-instance validation.
Liasoned between HM implementation teams and SoC Convergence team, preventing late-stage tape-out issues.
Established internal CAD methodologies and automated PI validation sign-off flows adopted across active production projects.
Served as primary engineering interface for Tier-1 accounts including Qualcomm (Bangalore), Atheros (Shanghai), STMicroelectronics, ST Ericsson, and Ericsson.
Supported RedHawk (SoC level power noise/reliability) and Totem (Transistor level power noise/reliability sign-off).
Drove customer engagements for new solutions, preparing training presentations, conducting workshops, and delivering custom feature prototyping for development teams.
Developed Perl scripts for automating the documentation of Linux kernel testing results.

internships.role: IC Design Front End Team Intern
bullets: Worked with the Central CAD & Infrastructure (CCI) IC design front-end team.
Exposure to thermal power generation plant methodology and combined cycle systems.

projects.title: Optimal Placement of Wind Turbines in a Wind Farm
projects.desc: Implemented Monte-Carlo simulation to determine the optimum placement of wind rotors in a wind farm considering wake effects.

projects.title: Wind Analysis Using Weibull Distribution
projects.desc: Fitted wind velocity profiles with a Weibull distribution to evaluate site wind power capacity.

projects.title: Communication Systems Signal Multiplexing
projects.desc: Designed a circuit model to multiplex 5 audio signals, perform FM modulation, and retrieve original signals without noise.

projects.title: Basic IC Tester Application
projects.desc: Designed and tested IC validation logic using 8086 microprocessor assembly.

projects.title: Component V-I Characteristics Plotter
projects.desc: Plotted V-I characteristics of electronic components on a graphical LCD using 8051 microcontroller.
